title: Silent Night, Deadly Night
blurb: The killer-Santa slasher that was pulled from cinemas after protests, two sequels about the same family, two numbered sequels that have nothing to do with them, and two remakes.

groups.title: Billy and Ricky
groups.note: The original and the two sequels about Billy's brother Ricky.

groups.title: The unrelated sequels
groups.note: Numbered as sequels, but separate stories.

groups.title: The remakes
groups.note: Two separate remakes of the 1984 film.

note: Part 2 spends roughly its first half replaying footage from the original, so watch the first film before it or skip straight to its second half. Parts 4 and 5 only share the title.
